testimonials.name: Priya Sharma
testimonials.quote: I had no idea how choice filling worked and almost put only 5 colleges. The counsellor helped me build a list of 45 choices with a proper safe-moderate-ambitious split. Got allotted in Round 2 — exactly where I wanted.

testimonials.name: Arjun Reddy
testimonials.quote: My parents and I were stressed about whether to take a private college seat in Round 1 or wait. The data-backed analysis showed me realistic options for Round 2 and mop-up, which gave us the confidence to float. Ended up upgrading to a much better college.

testimonials.name: Ananya Iyer
testimonials.college_name: Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute
testimonials.quote: The comparison tool saved me hours of manual research. I could see fee differences, seat matrices, and 3-year cutoff trends side by side. Made choice filling feel much less overwhelming.

testimonials.name: Dr. Rahul Mehra
testimonials.quote: For PG, the specialty-college combinations are insane — hundreds of permutations. Having historical cutoff data for each combination meant I didn't have to guess. Got Radiology at my top choice.

testimonials.name: Dr. Sneha Kulkarni
testimonials.quote: I was torn between Surgery at a mid-tier college and Medicine at a top one. The counsellor walked me through the bond implications and career trajectory for both. That clarity was worth everything.

testimonials.name: Dr. Vikram Singh
testimonials.quote: Got allotted in mop-up round after missing out in the regular rounds. The team helped me stay prepared with documents and alternative choices. Wouldn't have known about the stray vacancy process without their guidance.
